name: application-room-availability-grid
title: Room Availability Grid
description: Hotel room-inventory calendar with rooms as rows and dates as columns, each cell showing Free/Booked/Maintenance.
useWhen: Showing hotel front-desk staff which rooms are free, booked, or under maintenance across a range of dates.
You need a room-by-date matrix rather than a single room's calendar or a single day's room list.
A quick-glance status grid (not a full drag-to-book calendar) is enough for the current view.
avoidWhen: You're showing a person's meeting/time-slot availability (hour-by-day), not room inventory over dates — use `availability-grid` for that unrelated scheduling case.
Bookings can span partial days or need drag-to-select — this fixed per-day-cell grid doesn't support sub-day granularity; use a full calendar/timeline component instead.
There are more than a handful of rooms or dates — this grid is for a compact overview; paginate or virtualize for large inventories rather than shrinking cells.
responsiveBehavior: Grid columns are defined by the date count via CSS grid-template-columns; on narrow viewports the parent should scroll horizontally rather than the grid compressing cells below a legible width.
accessibility: Each cell carries role=img with an aria-label stating the room, date, and status in words, since the cell's visual content (a short status word) alone may not be sufficient context out of grid position.
Status is encoded by both background tint and the cell's own text label, never color alone, so it remains legible without color vision.
The legend at the bottom restates the three status colors with text labels, reinforcing the mapping for sighted users scanning quickly.

variants.title: Room Availability Grid
variants.description: Four rooms (101-104) across five dates (Aug 8-12) with Free/Booked/Maintenance cells and a legend.
accessibility: Free/Booked/Maintenance use a fixed three-way status mapping (emerald/red/neutral gray), never repurposed for an unrelated meaning.

variants.title: Room Availability Grid (Dark)
variants.description: Room availability grid adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status cells use low-opacity tinted backgrounds and matching rings to hold WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
